web_failures_and_truncation: Initial web opens of the final Pavešić bodies returned Internal Error; direct public-author-hosted retrieval then succeeded. Web screenshot references were not treated as visible pixels; local source-page renders were later actually viewed.
not_independently_recovered_bodies: This whole-package review did not reobtain every historical/citing body mentioned in the archived audits. Negative priority-search completeness is not certified.
